name: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind
what: A huge fantasy world from 2002 where you can go anywhere and be anyone.

fanProjects.name: OpenMW
fanProjects.what: Fans rebuilt the engine from scratch. It runs Morrowind on today's computers, with fixes and mod support.
howToPlay: Download OpenMW and follow its setup to find your game files.

lovedFeatures: Explore a big world on foot
Level up your skills by using them
extraFeatures: Join groups like a mages guild
scopeNote: A 3D open world is an epic. Make a small 2D adventure with one town and one dungeon first.
